request.prompt: Write a complete original instrumental for an atmospheric futuristic electric-car radio station. Strictly no voices, singing, speech, vocal chops, choir, whispers, or vocoder. Original melodies and sound design only; no quotations or samples of existing music. Polished warm stereo mix, controlled bass, smooth high frequencies, and space for vehicle sound effects. Start with an established pulse, develop a restrained recurring motif, vary the arrangement every eight bars, keep momentum throughout, and end on the ongoing groove without silence or a dramatic finale. Dark energetic analog synthwave at 112 BPM, 4/4, approximately 44 bars. Broad gated snare, firm electronic kick, rubbery octave synth bass, glassy arpeggiated lead and spacious minor-key analog chords. Cool white headlights reflected on a deserted neon expressway, confident and nocturnal, with a strong clear beat. Use a bright but melancholy four-note motif, metallic percussion fills and a gently evolving chord sequence.
